title: Etale cohomology of the local scheme at a point as a colimit over Zariski neighbourhoods
statement:
Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $\mathcal F$ an abelian sheaf on $X_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], $x\in X$, $\mathcal O_{X,x}$ the local ring [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk] and $g_x:\operatorname{Spec}\mathcal O_{X,x}\to X$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum] the canonical morphism [lem-weil-pbc-spec-local-ring-canonical-morphism]; for every open $U\ni x$ it factors uniquely as $g_x=j_U\circ g_{x,U}$ with $j_U:U\hookrightarrow X$ the open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion]. For an open $U\subseteq X$ write $H^q(U,\mathcal F)$ for the cohomology of $\mathcal F$ over the object $U\hookrightarrow X$ of $X_{\Et}$ (an open immersion is etale [lem-weil-pbc-open-immersion-etale]; [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] (2)), the restriction $H^q(U,\mathcal F)\to H^q(W,\mathcal F)$ for $W\subseteq U$ being induced by the restriction maps of an injective resolution of $\mathcal F$. Then $H^q(U,\mathcal F)=H^q(U_{\Et},j_U^{-1}\mathcal F)$ canonically, and the maps $H^q(U,\mathcal F)=H^q(U_{\Et},j_U^{-1}\mathcal F)\xrightarrow{g_{x,U}^*}H^q((\operatorname{Spec}\mathcal O_{X,x})_{\Et},g_{x,U}^{-1}j_U^{-1}\mathcal F)\cong H^q((\operatorname{Spec}\mathcal O_{X,x})_{\Et},g_x^{-1}\mathcal F)$ (pullback [def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback] followed by the canonical isomorphism $g_{x,U}^{-1}j_U^{-1}\cong g_x^{-1}$ of inverse images [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], [lem-weil-pbc-inverse-image-composition]; etale cohomology [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology]) are compatible with the restrictions and induce, for every $q\ge0$, an isomorphism
$$\varinjlim_{U\ni x\ \text{open}}H^q(U,\mathcal F)\xrightarrow{\ \sim\ }H^q((\operatorname{Spec}\mathcal O_{X,x})_{\Et},g_x^{-1}\mathcal F),$$
the colimit being over the open neighbourhoods of $x$ ordered by reverse inclusion (a directed set). In particular a class $\xi\in H^q(U,\mathcal F)$ whose image in $H^q((\operatorname{Spec}\mathcal O_{X,x})_{\Et},g_x^{-1}\mathcal F)$ is zero restricts to zero in $H^q(W,\mathcal F)$ for some open $x\in W\subseteq U$.

proof.text: Apply etaleOpenObjectCohomology_natural to obtain the natural comparison e of object cohomology with cohomology of restricted sheaves. This is the sole newly split obligation.

Mathlib Scheme.Opens.fromSpecStalkOfMem and fromSpecStalkOfMem_ι give the maps g and their factorization. Cancel the open immersion into X to prove uniqueness and compatibility with inclusion of neighbourhoods. These are existing Mathlib constructions, not an application of the separate canonical-morphism-properties theorem; only cancellation uses the open-immersion monomorphism node.

Conjugate the diagram maps by d followed by e. Its naturality equation cancels the intermediate inverse comparisons and gives the specified restricted-cohomology transitions. The proved fixed-base triangle laws show that the prescribed maps to local-scheme cohomology commute with these transitions. Construct the cocone B with that cohomology group as its point and b equal to the identity.

Apply etaleRestrictedCohomology_neighbourhood_colimit to the supplied diagram and the constructed cocone. This specialization is proved in the delivery from the affine-neighbourhood scheme limit, existing fixed-base continuity, and cofinality.

Injectivity of b makes a coprojection of a class with zero image equal to the coprojection of zero. Concrete.isColimit_exists_of_rep_eq gives a common smaller neighbourhood where the class and zero have equal restrictions. Additive maps preserve zero, giving the required eventual vanishing.

split_report.summary: Split along the proof of Stacks 09AX ('the stalk at x is colim H^p(U,F) = H^p(Spec O_{X,x}, G_x), see 03Q6'), with 03Q6 taken as the special case of 09YQ (existing reviewed node lem-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology-limit-of-schemes) applied to the directed system of affine open neighbourhoods of x, whose limit is Spec O_{X,x} (Limits, proof of 0GWT; new unsplit node lem-weil-pbc-local-ring-spec-limit-affine-neighbourhoods, which also carries the cofinality of the affine neighbourhoods and the unique factorization g_x = j_U o g_{x,U}). Seven steps: (1) H^q(U,F) = H^q(U_et, j_U^{-1}F) through the restricted injective resolution (03F3 (2); existing nodes cohomology-pullback-functorial (5) and etale-inverse-image-restriction (1)); (2) under it, restrictions are pullbacks along the inclusions composed with c (agent-written; from open-restriction-pullback-unit, inverse-image-composition (3) and the unit law of derived-inverse-image-composition (1)); (3) the maps theta_U of the statement are compatible with restrictions (functoriality (3),(4) of the pullback and associativity of c); (4) the limit theorem on the affine neighbourhoods; (5) the colimit sheaf is g_x^{-1}F (constant connected diagram); (6) identification of the systems and cofinality (colimit-initial-full-subcategory (1)); (7) the last assertion (filtered colimits elementwise). New Mathlib leaf lem-weil-pbc-open-immersion-etale (Etale.instOfIsOpenImmersion, Etale.lean:78) for the objects U -> X of X_et used by the statement. Statement unchanged in content; citations added for the stalk, the canonical morphism, open immersions being etale and the composition isomorphisms of inverse images, and the four ids added to stmt_deps. The citer lem-weil-pbc-gabber-strict-henselian-zariski-comparison (step 3) uses exactly the colimit isomorphism over all opens and the last assertion, both proved here.
